name: ❄️ WinterWare Demo ❄️
author: Ful
description:
A collection of 10 unique winter-inspired micro-games (made with accessibility in mind) included in one large package, which gradually becomes more difficult as your score increases.

If you would like to know more or download a bug-free version, then visit my itch.io page at https://fulv90.itch.io/winter-ware

Hope you all enjoy it and be sure to post your high-scores! 👍
